_doc: Cabinet drawer-opening variant used for the Q5 sim-to-real evaluation.
Success requires joint j_link_1 on cabinet_bottom_cabinet_ep1_1 to reach at least 0.2494 m.
The variant ends at drawer opening; placing an object inside and closing the drawer are not required.
Collection and evaluation apply this table at load time to replace the prompt and goal conditions.
Safety constraints are inherited from the benchmark task.
The opening threshold is calibrated from the achieved joint positions in five demonstrations (see _calibration).
The base, target, env and location conditions use the same bottom_cabinet model bamfsz and joint j_link_1, so the threshold is shared across these conditions.

_calibration.note: The threshold is 95% of the minimum achieved joint position, rounded to four decimal places. It is a lower bound: larger openings also satisfy the goal. Collection and evaluation use the same threshold.
